calls.video_title: A Dip Like This Only Comes Once a Decade
calls.price_at_call: ~18x next-year earnings; 3-yr forecast ~$3,000 per $1,000; medium confidence (first tracked BWB call)
calls.thesis: CONDITIONAL_BUY, first tracked — other warehouse name; most data-centre drives pre-sold through 2028, some cloud deals to 2030; beat estimates again and guided higher, yet slipped. CONDITIONAL_BUY — buy in pieces (dollar-cost average on the way down), not all at once; only while the memory shortage holds.
calls.base_case: Everything it can make above plan is already spoken for.
calls.bull_case: Pre-sold backlog carries pricing and volume through 2028.
calls.bear_case: Forecast assumes the stock keeps its richer ~18x multiple for three straight years.
